inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to finish renegotiating the 2009 agreement, and is threatening an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are not met. This looks less like an isolated labor dispute than a pressure game: years of delay have left universities exposed, while officials can now portray any disruption as the unions’ fault rather than answer for the stalled talks. The ultimatum came from SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council—but the real question is who benefits from keeping the dispute unresolved.
